name: Beckett Brass
description: Pirate captain and admiral who founded High and Dry, retook it from invasion, and became the Coalition's first Governor.

description_citations.text: "Stormwreck Sea". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass's Scourge rams Jareth Wake's Squid Eyes; the entangled ships stay afloat and the captains parley, founding High and Dry.
timeline.quote: After the Scourge rammed Squid Eyes , the two ships became impossibly entangled

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass turns back her expedition when she sees Realmbreaker's branches over the sky.
timeline.quote: she turned back when she saw Realmbreaker 's branches arcing over the ocean sky

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "The Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass retakes High and Dry, liberating its population, and becomes its sole leader; her fleet and original dream do not survive.
timeline.quote: she took command of High and Dry as the city's sole leader

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "The Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass declares the age of piracy over and forces a meeting of Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk factions to support a free pirate nation, declaring herself Governor.
timeline.quote: declared the age of piracy to be over

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass begins issuing cosmium prospecting deeds enforced by the Bluecoats to legitimize the Coalition as a state.
timeline.quote: Enforcing these deeds are the Bluecoats

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ships Scourge and Squid Eyes collide and tangle; Beckett Brass and Jareth Wake found High and Dry on the wreckage.
timeline.quote: Their captains — Beckett Brass and Jareth Wake — founded High and Dry on the wreckage

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "Early Days". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Admiral Beckett Brass notes ships on mean seas pick up ghosts.
timeline.quote: Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two.

citation.text: Spectral Sailor (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the outset of the Phyrexian invasion, Brass turns back from an expedition upon seeing Realmbreaker's branches.
timeline.quote: she turned back when she saw Realmbreaker 's branches arcing over the ocean sky

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "The Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass retakes High and Dry from the Phyrexians and becomes its sole leader.
timeline.quote: she took command of High and Dry as the city's sole leader

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "The Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion refugees crowd High and Dry; Brass and her fleet retake the city and she becomes de facto leader.
timeline.quote: Brass emerged as the de facto leader of the battered survivors.

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "The Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saheeli serves as Caztaca's scribe at a meeting with Elenda and Beckett Brass, convinces them to accept a deal and seals the treaty.
timeline.quote: In the end, Saheeli convinced the other two leaders to accept the deal.

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Omenpath era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Admiral Beckett Brass bursts in with armed pirates and takes control of the meeting.
timeline.quote: You came here on my ship, to haggle over nations on my island

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass demands that her coalition be recognized as a player on equal terms.
timeline.quote: my coalition demands recognition as a player of this game on equal terms.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass threatens to kill both leaders and blockade the seas if refused.
timeline.quote: Then I'll kill the two of you here and the stink of cannon smoke will choke Torrezon and Ixalan

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Saheeli urges the leaders to accept Brass's demand.
timeline.quote: Accept her demand

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca reveals the emperor is building a fleet of ten thousand ships to invade Alta Torrezon.
timeline.quote: The emperor is building another fleet of ten thousand ships

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass states the coalition's naval strength.
timeline.quote: We have six hundred fighting ships stocked and seaworthy, all veteran crews

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Elenda promises letters of marque and recognition of the coalition if Brass stops Vito's expedition.
timeline.quote: We will write you letters of marque

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca asks the coalition to burn the second Dawn Fleet and draw the army away from the capital.
timeline.quote: Burn those ships in their docks.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Caztaca gives Brass a feather, to be returned when Caztaca rules in Pachatupa in exchange for a nation.
timeline.quote: Return this to me when I rule in Pachatupa, and I will give you your nation.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The three leaders sign the contract Saheeli transcribed.
timeline.quote: One by one the three leaders signed, sealing their contract.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Brass and Elenda depart, each toasting a new world.
timeline.quote: Pleasure doing business with you two.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Jareth Wake builds enchanted instruments to find Brass, and Lex Briggs crafts six charms to confound him; Swab's trickery lets him find the Scourge.
timeline.quote: Swab's trickery disrupted Lex's charms just long enough for Jareth to set his course

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "High and Dry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass becomes Admiral of the Fathom Fleet.
timeline.quote: Captain Brass became Admiral Brass, in command of a disciplined, fearsome collection of ships

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "The Fathom Fleet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Facing angry crowds, Brass declares the age of piracy over and the Brazen Coalition a nation.
timeline.quote: declared the age of piracy to be over

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "Governor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass crashes a Sun Empire and Legion of Dusk meeting and forces support for a free pirate nation, declaring herself Governor.
timeline.quote: declaring herself Governor

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "Governor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass's ship is destroyed by a salamander wurm in Ixalan's Core, but she escapes with her crew and rebuilds it.
timeline.quote: she was able to escape with her crew and enough of her ship left to rebuild it

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "Governor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caztaca plots to depose her brother Atlacan, and Beckett Brass agrees to support two factions in exchange for a Brazen Coalition state.
timeline.quote: Hoping to prevent war, the emperor's sister Caztaca Huicintli plotted to depose her bellicose brother Atlacan

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year later Elenda meets Huatli, Saheeli, and Caztaca to negotiate an alliance; Beckett Brass interrupts demanding support for the Brazen Coalition.
timeline.quote: The meeting was interrupted by Admiral Beckett Brass

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Lost Caverns of Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire builds a second Dawn Fleet and Admiral Beckett Brass crashes a meeting, agreeing to support both factions for a Coalition state.
timeline.quote: Admiral Beckett Brass crashed a meeting of the two factions

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Rediscovery of the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Beckett Brass declares the age of piracy over, makes the Coalition a legitimate nation and becomes its first Governor.
timeline.quote: Beckett Brass declared the age of piracy over

citation.text: "Stormwreck Sea", section "New Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ships Scourge and Squid Eyes collide and tangle; Brass and Wake agree a truce and found High and Dry.
timeline.quote: agreeing to a truce when their ships became locked together

citation.text: "High and Dry", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Admiral Brass leads the fight to reclaim High and Dry, driving out the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Admiral Brass led the fight to reclaim the city, driving out the Phyrexians and reestablishing order.

citation.text: "High and Dry", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass declares the age of piracy over and becomes Governor of a new pirate nation seated at High and Dry.
timeline.quote: She assumed the title of Governor

citation.text: "High and Dry", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caztaca, Elenda and Beckett form an alliance bridging the Sun Empire, a faithful Legion faction and the Brazen Coalition; Vraska recruits Malcolm and Breeches.
timeline.quote: a political settlement was reached between Caztaca Huicintli

citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Governor Brass returns the former Deadeyes to the status of a national navy, the Bluecoats.
timeline.quote: the former Deadeyes returned to their old status as a national navy by Governor Brass

citation.text: "Wallis Parrish", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Beckett Brass's dinosaur poachers have been a threat to Ghalta's kind for generations.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

relations.quote: her trusted navigator and first mate, Lex Briggs

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "High and Dry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Beckett Brass", section "High and Dry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: the former Deadeyes returned to their old status as a national navy by Governor Brass
